description: Use when the user wants the news-feed view: markets whose probability spiked inside a 2, 12 or 24-hour window, scored by size of move times volume and grouped by event and topic; for a plain 24h ranking by size of move use `top_movers`, and for this feed grouped by category `news_movers_by_category`. The score is `|Δprob_pp| × log10(1+USD-equivalent volume)`. Refreshed after each Polymarket ingest cycle, typically every 15-20 min. The `window=` param selects the lookback: 24 (default, ≥15pp), 12 (≥12pp), or 2 (≥2h, ≥10pp); `d_prob` is measured over that window. Includes a `prob_history` array (24h bucketed trajectory) per row regardless of window. `prob`, `d_prob`, `prob_history` and `spike.peak_prob` are percentage points on a 0-100 scale; every other tool uses `probability` in [0, 1]. Real-money volumes use notional dollars and Manifold volume uses play-money mana. Each market row's `pdata_url` is its event page on pdata.world (null for a market with no event; topic clusters carry none). Filterable by `source=` and `categories=` (CSV). Soft flags (`is_entertainment`/`is_microprediction`/`is_crypto`/`is_sports`/`is_weather`) default OFF; opt in with `include_*=true`. Without a source filter, only venues eligible for cross-venue totals enter the count and ranking. Pass a source to read a venue-only feed.

categories.description: Category filter (CSV). Examples: 'Politics', 'Sports', 'Crypto', 'Weather'. Maps to events.categories assignments.
categories.title: Categories

include_entertainment.description: Include entertainment markets (default: excluded for signal-to-noise).
include_entertainment.title: Include Entertainment

include_resolved.description: Include markets closed in the last 24 hours with a qualifying pre-close move (default: excluded — news movers focus on live markets).
include_resolved.title: Include Resolved

min_score.description: Minimum spike score. Higher = more notable spikes only.
min_score.title: Min Score

ordering.description: Sort by USD-equivalent volume (vol, the default), spike score (score), or absolute probability change (d_prob, also called prob or recent).
ordering.title: NewsOrdering

q.description: Full-text search across market title and event title. Case-insensitive substring match.
q.title: Q

source.description: Platform ID(s); single value or comma-separated list. Allowed: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion, gemini, hyperliquid, mnx, seer, xo.
source.title: Source

window.description:
Lookback windows the carousel selector exposes (hours). An IntEnum
(not Literal[2,12,24]) because FastAPI coerces a query STRING to an
IntEnum member but NOT to an int literal — `?window=24` would 422
against a Literal even though the Python default 24 validates.
window.title: SpikeWindow
